title: The edit guard returns, re-keyed to the `@mandate` that governs the edited path, with one owned hook group per authored `@hook`
summary: This reverses milestone 5's B11 retirement of the guard at the mechanism level. @inventarch/steward-hook: the guard entry (runHook, and the host launcher's guard mode, which passes its arguments through) also accepts `--root <absolute root> --hook <identity>`, and evaluateMandateHook(root, hook, event) and printable(text) are exported. In that mode the input checks, path safety and managed-state protection of the existing guard run first (installation state, owned projection files, and while a hook or guard registration is owned the two Claude settings files and the cache launcher are refused with IA-HOOK-PROJECTION-MANAGED); the retired steward rule for .ia/src/systems/<name>/ is not applied and is not a fallback. The named hook must be one admitted authored (band 100) `@hook` that hook generation declares (PreToolUse; Write, Edit or MultiEdit; one or more workspace-relative path selections written with /; a non-blank message), otherwise every edit that registration receives is refused with IA-HOOK-DECLARATION-UNAVAILABLE naming the re-registration. The edit is decided only when the hook's tools name the event's tool and its paths, or the authored .ia/src/ tree, select the file; any other edit is allowed. A selected edit is governed by the mandates @inventarch/runtime's governingMandates returns for the path, plus, under .ia/src/, those scoped to the repository's own `@workspace`; with none it is allowed. An event carrying agent_id is a subagent acting as the composition.agent of the one authored `@agent-profile` named exactly its agent_type; any other event, including a main session launched with --agent (agent_type without agent_id), acts as the workspace's default actor (composition.steward, else its single participant). The edit is allowed when profileRefusal allows the author mode (Synthesis) for that actor, otherwise refused with IA-HOOK-NOT-MANDATED, the hook's message and the next command ia position --seat <mandate> --shape governance; an unknown subagent, a malformed agent_id, a subagent without agent_type or an actor that cannot be established under a participant's mandate is IA-HOOK-IDENTITY-UNAVAILABLE; an unreadable governing mandate or unreadable records is IA-HOOK-MANDATE-UNAVAILABLE; a selected path reached through a link or junction is IA-HOOK-PATH-UNSAFE. hook.paths and authority.covers are matched in the G06c dialect (only *, ? and / are special) with db pathKey applied to both sides, so where the volume folds names (win32, darwin) DOCS/x.md is under docs/** and Docs/**, and elsewhere case is significant. Refusal reasons are printed without terminal escape sequences, C0 or C1 controls, line separators or bidirectional controls, and bounded. @inventarch/runtime: HOOK_CODES gains IA-HOOK-DECLARATION-UNAVAILABLE, IA-HOOK-MANDATE-UNAVAILABLE and IA-HOOK-NOT-MANDATED; the package root exports evaluateMandateGuard(handle, within, request), mandateGuardSelects(request) and GUARDED_SOURCES with the MandateGuardRequest and MandateGuardDecision types; GoverningOptions gains an optional fold key, and without it governingMandates is unchanged. @inventarch/distribution: the ./guard-registration subpath exports HOOK_TOOLS, hookStatePath, hookGroup, savedHooks, planHookRegistration(root, {cache, hooks} | {remove}), planHooksFor(root, expected, hooks) and applyHookRegistration(plan, checkpoint?) with the HookRow, HookTool, HookRequest, HookAction and HookPlan types: one PreToolUse group per hook row in .claude/settings.local.json whose matcher names the row's tools and whose handler runs `guard --root <root> --hook <identity>` in the retired guard's fixed derivation, owned by exact match against .ia/distributions/hosts/claude-hooks-<id>.json (ia.hook-registration-state.v1), published under the host lock through guard-pending.json (format ia.hook-registration-pending.v1), and recovered by recoverGuardRegistration (recover-guard). Unrelated groups, keys and bytes are kept; a re-plan of the same rows writes nothing; removing the last hook restores the file byte for byte. guardNode takes an optional hook identity, assertRetirableGuard and the retired guard's removal ignore groups that name --hook, and the launcher's guard mode description names --hook. Limits: no command registers hook groups yet, so ia host, ia project and the install refresh still register none and still retire a 1.x steward-guard registration, and until the projection writer applies them no release guards an edit; Codex hooks remain unsupported; excluded words are not enforced by the guard (record authoring enforces them); the guard reads records, not file bytes, and a mandate grants no host permission; Claude Code on win32 runs the direct form, which still fails open when its Node cannot start; the nine machine routes, MACHINE_PROTOCOL versions 1 and 2 and every ia scope form are unchanged.
